questions.text: What is software and software engineering? Explain the nature and characteristics of software. Differentiate between software engineering and other engineering disciplines.
What are software myths? Discuss management myths, customer myths, and practitioner myths with suitable examples.
What is software crisis? Discuss the major factors responsible for software crisis and how software engineering principles help overcome it.
What is legacy software? Why is it challenging to maintain and evolve legacy software systems?
What is a software process framework? Explain generic framework activities and umbrella activities in software engineering.
Explain the Classical Waterfall Model and its extensions. Discuss its advantages, limitations, and suitability for real-world projects.
Explain Evolutionary Process Models: Prototyping Model and Boehm's Spiral Model with its four quadrant activities and risk assessment.
What is Agile Software Development? Explain the 12 principles of Agile Manifesto. Differentiate between Agile vs Plan-Driven (Traditional) process models.

Explain the Scrum Framework: Scrum Roles (Product Owner, Scrum Master, Dev Team), Artifacts (Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, Burn-down chart), and Ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective).
Explain Extreme Programming (XP) core practices: Pair Programming, Test-Driven Development (TDD), Refactoring, Collective Code Ownership, and Continuous Integration.
Explain the Requirements Engineering process: Inception, Elicitation (Interviews, Surveys, JAD), Elaboration, Negotiation, Specification, and Validation.
What is Software Requirements Specification (SRS)? What are the characteristics of a good SRS document? Describe its structure according to IEEE 830 standard.
Differentiate between Functional and Non-Functional Requirements with suitable examples from an E-Commerce or Banking system.
Explain Agile Requirements Engineering: User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Story Mapping, and Product Backlog grooming.
What is Software Architecture? Explain architectural design principles and the importance of architecture in managing system complexity.
Explain taxonomy of Architectural Styles: Layered Architecture, Client-Server (2-tier/3-tier), Model-View-Controller (MVC), Pipe-and-Filter, and Microservices Architecture with diagrams.

Explain modular design principles. Differentiate between Cohesion and Coupling. Explain types of Cohesion (Functional, Sequential, Communicational, etc.) and Coupling (Data, Stamp, Control, Common, Content).
What is Data Flow Diagram (DFD)? Draw Context Level (Level 0) and Level 1 DFD for an Online Library Management or Hospital Management System.
What is Use Case Modeling? Draw a Use Case Diagram for an E-Commerce System showing Actors, Use Cases, and `<<include>>` and `<<extend>>` relationships.
Construct a Class Diagram for an ATM / Hospital Management System showing classes, attributes, methods, associations, multiplicity, and generalizations.
Construct an Activity Diagram with swimlanes, decision nodes, and fork/join synchronization bars for an Online Food Delivery or Ride-Booking System.
Differentiate between Verification and Validation in software testing with suitable examples.
Explain Code Review techniques: Code Walkthrough vs Code Inspection vs Cleanroom engineering.
Explain Black-Box Testing techniques: Equivalence Class Partitioning (ECP) and Boundary Value Analysis (BVA). Design test cases for an input integer field accepting age between 18 and 60.
Explain White-Box Testing: Statement Coverage, Branch Coverage, and Condition Coverage. Draw Control Flow Graph (CFG) and calculate Cyclomatic Complexity $V(G) = E - N + 2P$ for a given C/Java code.
Explain Software Testing Levels: Unit Testing, Integration Testing (Top-Down with stubs, Bottom-Up with drivers, Big-Bang), System Testing, and Acceptance Testing (Alpha vs Beta testing).
Explain Agile Testing practices: Test-Driven Development (TDD), Automated Unit Testing, Continuous Testing, and Refactoring for code quality.
Define Software Quality. Explain McCall's Quality Factors (Product Operation, Product Revision, Product Transition).
Explain Software Quality Assurance (SQA). Differentiate between SQA and Software Testing.
Explain ISO 9001 quality standards and SEI Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI) 5 maturity levels.
Explain Software Maintenance and its four types: Corrective, Adaptive, Perfective, and Preventive maintenance with examples.
What is Software Configuration Management (SCM)? Explain SCM repository, baselines, and Change Control Board (CCB) change management process.
Explain Version Control Systems (Git), Git-flow branching strategies (main, develop, feature, release, hotfix branches), and Continuous Integration.
Explain DevOps and Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines in modern software engineering projects.
Explain Cloud-Native Architecture, Microservices vs Monolithic architectures, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Discuss AI-Assisted Software Development (AI code generation, automated test generation), Low-Code/No-Code platforms, and Green Software Engineering.
